home.title: Where Luxor University Research Meets Real-World Challenges
home.subtitle: Researchers share innovations, companies present challenges, and the review team manually records potential matches.

innovations.palmRoofingDesc: Lightweight insulated panels made from palm waste, tested for heat resistance in hot climates.
innovations.solarIrrigationDesc: Low-cost controller scheduling irrigation based on soil moisture with a small solar panel, designed for Upper Egypt farms.

challenges.coolingChallengeDesc: A fruit supplier needs cooling that reduces electricity costs without harming product quality.
challenges.caneWaterChallenge: Reducing Water Loss in Sugarcane Canals
challenges.caneWaterChallengeDesc: A sugar company seeks practical solutions to measure and reduce leakage across 40 km of canals.

howItWorksSteps.step1Desc: Researchers and companies create an account.
howItWorksSteps.step2Desc: Send an innovation or challenge with attachments.
howItWorksSteps.step3Desc: Management determines the status after review.
howItWorksSteps.step4Desc: Reviewers compare general summaries and record matches.
